description: Two records are read and displayed, end of file is reached cleanly, and then CLOSE at :138 reports '42'. 9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE takes its :141 arm, ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT at :142, and :147-150 run. Eight lines and RETURN-CODE 12. Two properties are pinned that no other case can pin: the close failure's three lines come AFTER every record line, because :83 follows the loop; and there is NO 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT03C' line, because :150 abends before :85. The close paragraph also writes its APPL-RESULT arithmetic the long way round - ADD 8 TO ZERO GIVING at :137 and SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT at :140 where the open paragraph uses plain MOVEs - and the values are identical either way.
